usage: Third-Party Actions should be pinned to a specific release
name: Third-Party Actions should be pinned to a specific release
description: When using a Third-Party action, it is safer to tie an Action to a specific version than the latest version.
detailedDescription: A compromise of a single action within a workflow can be very significant, as that compromised action would have access to all secrets configured on your repository and may be able to use the GITHUB_TOKEN to write to the repository. Consequently, there is a significant risk in sourcing actions from third-party repositories on GitHub.
notes: This policy currently only applies to GitHub.

args.name: RepoType
args.label: Repo Visibility
args.tooltip: Determine if this policy applies to public repos, private repos or both.

args.name: skipVerified
args.label: Skip Verified Creators
args.tooltip: If the repo creator is verified, no violation will occur

args.name: excludedActions
args.label: Exclude actions
args.tooltip: If the repo creator is excluded, no violation will occur
